text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
(Coming to observe today was totally the 
right call♪\nWatching those rough diamonds 
run has really sharpened my instincts to 
perfection~♪)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Um, Beauty-san! Your new racing outfit... 
It's a collaboration with someone, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! You have quite the keen eye, 
King-chan! The collaboration hasn't even 
been announced yet... Don't tell me you 
figured it out just from the visuals?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course! That circular design is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Because that's the motif used by... the 
mother I know best of all—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahem, o-ohoho! Still, to think 
Beauty-san would team up with someone! 
...How was your partner's performance?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mmm~... Well, yes, her dedication to 
the craft was truly a beauty!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I even factored in the movement of the 
hem. With sequins scattered along the 
skirt's edge, light will burst and sparkle 
every time I run...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You truly understand the moment when 
Umamusume shine brightest. Your skill is 
impressive, but your passionate philosophy 
is even more so.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...! So it's amazing even from 
Beauty-san's perspective...!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm burning with a fierce 
desire not to lose either. I'm gonna 
create my absolute best design ever!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Your opponent is quite capable 
too, managing to light a fire under 
Beauty-san. ............Fufufu, not bad at 
all."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. As expected............ of a 
top-class designer."
